title: Runtime lifecycle
description: Server-authoritative target, convergence, Provider, and Runner status.

reasons.runtimeRemovalInProgress: Permanent Runtime removal is in progress. Lifecycle actions remain unavailable until it completes.
reasons.runtimeFailed: The current lifecycle generation failed. Review the available recovery actions.
reasons.providerFailed: The Provider reported that the Runtime resource failed.
reasons.runtimeRecreationRequired: The desired configuration differs from the applied Runtime. Recreation is required.
reasons.providerDisabled: The selected Runtime Provider is disabled.
reasons.providerWorkspaceUnavailable: The selected Runtime Provider is unavailable to this Workspace.
reasons.providerDisconnected: The Provider connection is unavailable, so the requested transition cannot currently converge.
reasons.providerCapabilityUnavailable: The Provider does not currently expose the required capabilities.
reasons.providerCapabilityInvalid: The Provider capability report is invalid.
reasons.profileDocumentInvalid: The selected Runtime Profile configuration is invalid.
reasons.profileIncompatible: The selected Runtime Profile is incompatible with the Provider.
reasons.runtimeConfigurationBlocked: The desired Runtime configuration is blocked.
reasons.runtimeProfileRequired: Choose an available Runtime Profile before creating Runtime resources.
reasons.runtimeResetting: The Runtime is resetting. Agent Workspace data is being cleared.
reasons.runtimeRecovering: The Provider is recovering the Runtime resource.
reasons.runtimeStarting: The Runtime is converging toward the running target.
reasons.runtimeStopping: The Runtime is converging toward the stopped target.
reasons.runnerUnknown: Runner readiness has not been observed yet.
reasons.runnerDisconnected: The Runtime resource is running, but the Runner connection is unavailable.
reasons.runnerStarting: The Runtime resource is running while the Runner starts.
reasons.unknown: The Runtime is unavailable for a bounded server-reported reason.
